nodes.title: Add data export and import
nodes.summary: Add an export button and an import button. Export reads the data stored in IndexedDB, generates a JSON object from it, zips it and downloads the zip file to the user's machine. Import does the exact reverse: it accepts the zipped JSON file, unzips and parses it, and seeds the data into IndexedDB. Covers [fb_5c04859a-c8d1-4bd6-b9e7-79174b2fd559].
